stories.title: The Cruel Warrior's Dragon Trophies
stories.summary: Fulfill the hunter's demand for three different dragon scales and his broken lance. Supplied trophies are accepted. Auriam's own reward and the faerie guard's exchange share some of these materials.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a gold dragon scale
steps.hint: Auriam carries a gold dragon scale and also awards one for helping her. Her scale is distinct from Nuriem's green-hued scale and Altrucali's brown-hued scale. Materials supplied by another player are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a broken mithral lance
steps.hint: Auriam carries the broken lance. The faerie guard in the Twisted Wood also accepts it. Auriam leaves after her own exchange, so secure the lance first if you intend to use that route. Materials supplied by another player are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a green-hued gold dragon scale
steps.hint: Nuriem carries the green-hued scale. She can range beyond Pine Hollow; her source is separate from her mother's valley encounter. Materials supplied by another player are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x the brown-hued scale of an elder gold dragon
steps.hint: Altrucali carries the brown-hued scale. He can range beyond Pine Hollow. His scale is distinct from Nuriem's and Auriam's. Materials supplied by another player are accepted.

steps.text: Return all three distinct scales and the broken lance to the cruel warrior
steps.hint: He awards a dragonscale earring, golden dagger, dragonscale collar, sword of the blessed and gold dragon scale, then leaves. Supplied trophies are accepted.

stories.title: Help the Wounded Gold Dragon
stories.summary: Help Auriam oppose the cruel warrior and Clamphorl by delivering their exact equipment. Supplied equipment is accepted. Auriam departs after rewarding you with a scale and her horn.

steps.hint: The cruel warrior wields this sword. Carry it with his black platemail and Clamphorl's totem for Auriam's exchange. Materials supplied by another player are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a full suit of black platemail
steps.hint: The cruel warrior wears this platemail. The faerie guard in the Twisted Wood also accepts it; that separate reward does not prepare the armor for Auriam. Materials supplied by another player are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x the totem of dark spirits
steps.hint: Clamphorl carries the totem of dark spirits and can range beyond Pine Hollow. The duergar mine is a separate exploration route. Materials supplied by another player are accepted.

steps.text: Bring the black sword, black platemail and dark-spirit totem to Auriam
steps.hint: Auriam awards a gold dragon scale and her horn, then leaves. Secure any other materials you need from her before completing this exchange.

stories.title: A Brown Bear Jacket
stories.summary: Darlene makes one jacket of brown bearskin. This commission uses three brown skins and no coin fee. Supplied skins or pelts are accepted. The other garments are independent commissions.

steps.text: Carry 3 x a brown bear skin
steps.hint: Brown bears in the forest carry brown bear skins. Bring three of this exact kind; black and huge bear skins serve different commissions. Materials supplied by another player are accepted.

steps.text: Trade three brown bear skins with Darlene for a jacket
steps.hint: Darlene makes one jacket of brown bearskin. This commission uses three brown skins and no coin fee.

stories.title: Black Bear Leggings
stories.summary: Darlene makes one pair of black bearskin leggings. This commission uses three ordinary black skins and no coin fee. Supplied skins or pelts are accepted. The other garments are independent commissions.

steps.text: Carry 3 x a black bear skin
steps.hint: Black bears in the forest carry these skins. Bring three ordinary black bear skins for leggings; huge bear skins are for the coat. Materials supplied by another player are accepted.

steps.text: Trade three black bear skins with Darlene for leggings
steps.hint: Darlene makes one pair of black bearskin leggings. This commission uses three ordinary black skins and no coin fee.

stories.title: A Heavy Bear Coat
stories.summary: Darlene makes one heavy bearskin coat. Both skins must be the huge kind; ordinary black skins serve the leggings request. Supplied skins or pelts are accepted. The other garments are independent commissions.

steps.text: Carry 2 x a huge bear skin
steps.hint: The large black bear carries a huge bear skin. This coat needs two; a single skin is insufficient. Confirm a supply of both skins before planning the exchange. Materials supplied by another player are accepted.

steps.text: Trade two huge bear skins with Darlene for a coat
steps.hint: Darlene makes one heavy bearskin coat. Both skins must be the huge kind; ordinary black skins serve the leggings request.

stories.title: Badgerskin Boots
stories.summary: Darlene makes one pair of badgerskin boots. This commission uses three pelts and no coin fee. Supplied skins or pelts are accepted. The other garments are independent commissions.

steps.hint: Large badgers in the forest carry these pelts. Bring three together for one pair of boots. Materials supplied by another player are accepted.

steps.text: Trade three badger pelts with Darlene for boots
steps.hint: Darlene makes one pair of badgerskin boots. This commission uses three pelts and no coin fee.

stories.title: A Red Fox Stole
stories.summary: Darlene makes one red fox stole. This commission uses three pelts and no coin fee. Supplied skins or pelts are accepted. The other garments are independent commissions.

steps.text: Carry 3 x a red fox pelt
steps.hint: Crafty red foxes in the wooded valley and western approaches carry these pelts. Bring three together; a separate Ice Crag request also uses a fox pelt. Materials supplied by another player are accepted.

steps.text: Trade three red fox pelts with Darlene for a stole
steps.hint: Darlene makes one red fox stole. This commission uses three pelts and no coin fee.

introduction: Explore a forest troubled by dragon hunters, a hostile logging village, and its concealed mine.
orientation: Meet visible people to reveal their requests. Auriam and the cruel warrior begin in the forest valley; Darlene trades skins in the village.
Ask about the listed topics. The dragon accounts lead to different exchanges; supplied materials are accepted, and each request has its own reward.
Read the sign in Darlene's Trading Post for her five clothing commissions. Keep the exact skins or pelts you intend to trade in your inventory.
The village's guarded mine and smelter use different keys. Hidden passages beneath the mine lead to a duergar refuge; these exploration leads have no local quest completion.

contacts.name: a cruel warrior
contacts.description: The hunter begins in the forest valley. Ask about his search, lance, Auriam and her children to learn his trophy demand.

contacts.name: Auriam
contacts.description: The wounded gold dragon begins in the forest valley. Ask about her scar to learn about the warrior and Clamphorl.

contacts.name: Darlene
contacts.description: Darlene works in the village trading post. Read her sign and ask about each garment; her exchanges use skins and pelts.
